title: 第1章 修仙界我秦宇大帝来了第2章 复制灵根
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
清晨！
明媚的阳光驱散晨雾，照亮幽静的小院。
秦宇起床伸了个懒腰。
“真是美好的一天啊！”
“等我通过测试，加入宗门，从此修仙界又多了一颗冉冉升起的新星，哦吼吼吼吼吼......”
今天是玄天宗一年一度招收新弟子的日子，为此秦宇已等待一年之久。
穿好衣服，背起行李，秦宇取了一包炸好的臭豆腐，迈出了房门。
一年前！
秦宇还在一颗蓝色星球上打游戏，在经历了三十连跪后，突然气血上涌，眼前一黑。
再次醒来便穿越到这个少年身上。
关于原主的大部分记忆已经丢失，依稀只记得什么‘修仙’、‘宗门选拔’、‘强盗’、‘身受重伤’……
起初秦宇还以为原主是看小说看傻了，后来稍一打听，嘴里便只剩下一句‘卧槽’！
他真的穿越到了一个可以修仙的世界。
仅仅用了一秒钟，秦宇便将修仙当做了自己的第一目标。
敢问哪个男人能拒绝的了飞天遁地，御剑飞行的诱惑。
最重要的是，秦宇要成仙之后返回蓝星，把灵剑架在游戏设计者的脖子上，好好问问他，自己为什么会三十连跪。
当时正值玄天宗招收新弟子，秦宇一路赶到玄天宗，才得知玄天宗招新已经结束。
秦宇干脆在小镇租了一间小房子。
平日里靠着祖传的手艺制作臭豆腐赚取日常开销。
......

秦宇背着背包，走在小镇最为热闹的大街上。
因为玄天宗选拔的缘故，小镇里多了很多生面孔。
卖早餐的店铺生意火爆，很是热闹。
秦宇轻车熟路的走到一处摊位前。
看到正在忙碌的老板娘，眼前顿时浮现出一道文字。
【无奸不商（d级）】：天生的小商小贩，能够凭借小聪明轻松赚取超额的利润，成为附近小有名气的黑店老板。
（可复制）
对此，秦宇早就习以为常。
穿越过来后，他便绑定了系统，拥有了查看别人天赋的能力。
并且，他还有一次可以复制‘d级’天赋的机会。
天赋并非所有人都有，出现天赋的人群大约只占千分之一！
而且，秦宇认为系统的探测功能也不一定正确。
就比如眼前的老板娘，价格实惠，从不缺斤少两。
平日里对秦宇也很不错，甚至在秦宇刚来到小镇手里没钱时，还主动送给秦宇食物。
这么善良的人怎么可能是黑店老板？
系统纯属就在胡扯。
“胖婶，一个肉火烧，一碗豆腐脑！”
秦宇笑着说道。
“好嘞，总共200铜钱，客官里面坐！”
‘我靠，真黑！

秦宇笑容一僵，他怀疑自己是不是听错了，这些东西平时只卖两枚铜钱啊。
胖婶抬起头，看到来人是秦宇后，一把拉秦宇到身边，小声问道：
content_en:
early morning!
The bright sunshine disperses the morning fog and illuminates the quiet courtyard.
Qin Yu got up and stretched.
"What a wonderful day!"
"When I pass the test and join the sect, there will be another rising star in the world of immortality. Oh ho ho ho ho ho..."
Today is the annual day for Xuantian Sect to recruit new disciples, for which Qin Yu has been waiting for a year.
After getting dressed and carrying his luggage, Qin Yu took a bag of fried stinky tofu and walked out of the room.
a year ago!
Qin Yu was still playing games on a blue planet. After kneeling for thirty consecutive times, his blood suddenly surged and his vision went dark.
When he wakes up again, he travels back to this young man.
Most of the memory about the original owner has been lost, and he only vaguely remembers things like 'cultivation', 'sect selection', 'robber', 'seriously injured'...
At first, Qin Yu thought that the original owner was reading a novel and was stupid, but after asking about it for a while, all he could say was 'f*ck'!
He really traveled to a world where he could cultivate immortality.
It only took a second for Qin Yu to regard cultivating immortality as his first goal.
I dare to ask which man can resist the temptation of flying to the sky, escaping to the earth, and flying with a sword.
The most important thing is that Qin Yu wants to return to Blue Star after becoming an immortal, put the spiritual sword on the neck of the game designer, and ask him why he knelt for thirty consecutive years.
At that time, Xuantian Sect was recruiting new disciples. Qin Yu rushed all the way to Xuantian Sect, only to learn that Xuantian Sect's recruitment had ended.
Qin Yu simply rented a small house in a small town.
On weekdays, he relies on his ancestral craftsmanship to make stinky tofu to earn daily expenses.
...
Qin Yu was carrying a backpack and walking on the busiest street in the town.
Because of the selection of Xuantian Sect, there are many new faces in the town.
The shop selling breakfast is very busy and busy.
Qin Yu walked to a stall with ease.
Seeing the busy boss lady, a text suddenly appeared in front of my eyes.
[No treacherous businessman (Level D)]: A born small business hawker who can easily earn excess profits with his cleverness and become a famous black shop owner nearby.
(can be copied)
Qin Yu has long been accustomed to this.
After traveling through time, he was bound to the system and gained the ability to view other people's talents.
Moreover, he has another chance to copy his 'D-level' talent.
Not everyone has talent, only about one in a thousand people have talent!
Moreover, Qin Yu believes that the system’s detection function may not be correct.
Just like the boss lady in front of me, the prices are affordable and she never lacks anything.
He is also very kind to Qin Yu on weekdays, and even took the initiative to give Qin Yu food when Qin Yu first came to the town and had no money.
How could such a kind person be the owner of a black shop?
The system is bullshit.
"Fat aunt, one roasted meat and one bowl of tofu curd!"
Qin Yu said with a smile.
"Okay, a total of 200 copper coins, I'll sit in the guest room!"
‘Holy shit, it’s so dark!
Qin Yu's smile froze. He wondered if he heard wrongly. These things usually only cost two copper coins.
The fat aunt raised her head and saw that the person coming was Qin Yu. She pulled Qin Yu to her side and asked in a low voice:
